mod.help: Settings for the Passive Runes mod.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.help: Turns the passive rune rewards on or off.

interval.label: Interval (ms)
interval.help: How often you get runes, in milliseconds (1000 = 1 second). 0 pauses the interval rewards.

amount.label: Amount
amount.help: Runes you get each time. Negative takes runes away.

next_level.label: Next Level (%)
next_level.help: Each time, also get this percent of the runes needed for your next level. Negative takes runes away.

interest.label: Interest (%)
interest.help: Each time, also get this percent of the runes you hold. Grows fast. Negative takes runes away.

log.label: Log file
log.help: Write a log file next to the DLL, for troubleshooting.
